capitals change the split because uppercase pieces were rare in training, not because pre-tokenization cuts them.","fix":"Replace it with a case note tied to the merges, e.g. \"capitals were rare in training, so fewer learned merges join them\", instead of listing capitals as a pre-tokenization wall."},{"beatId":"b5","category":"small_stat_card","severity":"advisory","owner":"scriptwriter","fields":["stat_cards"],"evidence":[{"kind":"stat_card","quote":"3"},{"kind":"narration","quote":"and PARIS needs three"}],"problem":"The card \"3 / tokens for PARIS\" repeats a count of three that the narration already says and that the three TOKEN slots in \"ALL CAPS\" already draw.","fix":"Drop the stat card and let the three-slot grid carry the count."},{"beatId":"b7","category":"missing_trade_off","severity":"advisory","owner":"scriptwriter","fields":["narration"],"evidence":[{"kind":"narration","quote":"So Corrowby counts tokens with the exact tokenizer of the model it calls"},{"kind":"note","quote":"You must ship and run the exact tokenizer and build per-language reporting; the team still argues over whether to use per-language tables or count every message."}],"problem":"The ending presents counting with the model's own tokenizer as a free fix, while the cost the notes attach to it — shipping and running that exact tokenizer and building per-language reporting — never appears.","fix":"Add one short clause to the closing line noting that this means shipping and running the model's exact tokenizer, keeping the time by trimming words elsewhere in the same line."}]}
